Message.Name: Sequence Number Reset Message
Message.Description: Sent to reset the sequence number at start of day and in response to failures. The message carries its own valid sequence number in the header.

Field.Name: NextSeqNumber
Field.Description: The sequence number the recipient should expect in the immediately succeeding data packet.

Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Sent to subscribers connected to the Tcp retransmission server to show the connection is still alive. There is no message body.

Message.Name: Message Unavailable Message
Message.Description: Sent when the requested messages cannot be retransmitted.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNum
Field.Description: The first sequence number that is unavailable.

Field.Name: EndSeqNum
Field.Description: The last sequence number that is unavailable.

Message.Name: Refresh Quote Message
Message.Description: Sent in response to a Refresh Quote Request, and automatically when there are intraday symbol additions. The same body as a Quote message with the symbol and Cusip appended.

Field.Name: Symbol Index
Field.Description: The numerical representation of the symbol.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The quote generation time, in milliseconds since midnight of the same day.

Field.Name: QuoteLinkID
Field.Description: Identifies a unique quote, allowing quotes to be correlated to the last sale. For future use.

Field.Name: AskPriceNumerator
Field.Description: Ask price for the quote, scaled by the PriceScaleCode.

Field.Name: AskSize
Field.Description: Size of the quote on the ask side, in shares.

Field.Name: BidPriceNumerator
Field.Description: Bid price for the quote, scaled by the PriceScaleCode.

Field.Name: BidSize
Field.Description: Size of the quote on the bid side, in shares.

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: The power of ten that is the common denominator for the price numerators in this message. A price of 27.56 is a numerator of 2756 with a PriceScaleCode of 2.

Field.Name: ExchangeID
Field.Description: The originating exchange of the quote.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: The security type for this message.

Field.Name: QuoteCondition
Field.Description: The condition of the quote. Nyse Arca will only send quote condition R.

Field.Name: FlatPricing
Field.Description: Whether flat pricing or interest pricing is in effect.

Field.Name: Trading Action
Field.Description: The current state of trading for this bond.

Field.Name: FILLER
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The bond symbol.

Field.Name: Cusip
Field.Description: The bond Cusip.

Message.Name: Symbol Index Mapping Message
Message.Description: Maps a symbol index to its bond symbol and Cusip.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The numerical representation of the symbol.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The bond symbol.

Field.Name: Cusip
Field.Description: The bond Cusip.

Field.Name: FILLER
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.
